# Housekeeping: transient-shaper

## Authorized scope and smallest closable slice

Review the complete `crates/transient-shaper` Cargo package and its tests. Deliver practical, behavior-preserving cleanup in this package, or an evidenced no-change verdict when existing choices earn their cost. Cover all five user requests: repeated code/LoC; load-bearing test purposes; avoidable copies; applicable micro SIMD; and data structures that cap efficiency. The user requests two GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh agents concurrently; this overrides the default Terra implementation model for this workflow. Root Sol owns briefing, adversarial review, exact-path checkpoints, integration and remote synchronization.

## Frozen boundaries

Existing public APIs, feature behavior, canonical/wire identities, arithmetic order and per-lane rendered bits, latency/tail, link modes, smoothing and NaN/denormal rules remain contractual. Zero render allocations/frees, locks, I/O or syscalls; no runtime native ISA dispatch. Retain scalar tails, 4-lane Wasm/NEON and x86 AVX2/FMA. Preserve all feature and target configurations. Do not expand another open issue or change DSP algorithms. Read current related issue bodies before touching their subject; discoveries that require architecture or product decisions become bounded follow-ups and final owner questions.

## Implementation and test-value decisions

Prefer deleting or consolidating repetition to adding abstractions that increase total complexity. Assess every existing test or a clearly named homogeneous family by its plausible unique defect; remove trivial, redundant or obsolete cases only after identifying the surviving behavioral gate. Keep independent numeric/oracle, fault, allocation, queue, boundary and target tests. Add/rewrite tests only for a concrete uncovered defect, and state which plausible defect no existing test catches. No prose/source-grep tests, new bit-digest pins or exact resource-byte pins. Copies needed for ownership, snapshots or atomic admission stay unless the same semantics are proved with less work. Data structure changes must preserve deterministic order and bounded realtime work. Inspect applicable hot loops and generated code before claiming additional SIMD; recursive/stateful dependencies alone do not justify changing arithmetic.

## Objective gates and evidence

- Read all production and test files in this package; record concise findings for each of the five requests, concrete changed/deferred locations, and load-bearing test families with retained coverage for deletions.
- Run focused locked package tests and affected feature configurations; use existing downstream/RT/differential gates proportional to the changed contract. Check formatting and package clippy with warnings denied. Relevant Wasm and AArch64 compile checks are required for changed product code; record limitations candidly.
- Changes to DSP arithmetic or hot state need existing independent numeric and scalar/SIMD gates plus one-time base/head evidence when needed; no permanent comparison against the old implementation. Existing research remains the algorithm authority; no new algorithm or listening claim is authorized.
- Benchmarks are optional and descriptive. Any timed measurement freezes its workload/validator, passes zero-workload preflight, and runs exactly one invocation with one warmup/two measured rounds. No timing optimization loop, performance percentage or unsupported sound-quality claim.
- Root conducts one adversarial verdict per coherent attempt, at most five total attempts. Every new/rewritten test gets its unique-defect sentence in that verdict. No-change audits require the same five-axis review, not manufactured edits.
- Stop after a coherent compiling, focused-green tranche; root commits exact owned paths before further edits. Keep edits within `crates/transient-shaper` and this numbered spec. Independent crates use separate worktrees. Root pushes promptly and updates this GitHub issue with evidence; close only after PASS and evidence upstream, verifying remote state. Merge through the required qualification check and remove clean completed worktrees.

### Attempt 1 — worker A, 2026-10-01

Read all 15 package files (manifest, three source modules, ten test/prose files and common helpers) before implementation. Related current boundaries reviewed: #559/#560 and FX4's #635/#643/#645 disposition; #894 silent-block admission; #1018 Apple stored-splat lowering; #1073 public D7 reports. None is implemented here. Root authorized the SHA-only manifest/owned lock-row amendment at af066f02; product checkpoint bbfbb735 is upstream through 93d7d667.

**Five review axes.** Repetition: bank binding now starts its member loop at index 1 because the first metadata/defaults were already validated and seeded; every later active/padded member is still validated before incompatible/native-width fallback. Tests: two narrower active cases retired with the survivor map below, the fixed-array length assertion and paired SHA comparisons removed; no new test, generator or schedule. Copies: partition drivers render borrowed mutable subranges instead of allocating two scratch planes and copying them back per block, immutable reference bit vectors are built once per schedule family, and the bank restore donor is borrowed. Independent oracle input copies, scalar-vs-bank owned planes, atomic restore decoding and fixed lane extraction/serialization buffers remain necessary; the proposed oracle rewrite was skipped because exchanging buffers would not reduce work. Data structures: the width gate sorts/deduplicates its existing scalar word vector after all comparisons, replacing a separate HashSet while preserving the distinct-word threshold. RT state/ramps remain bounded fixed arrays. SIMD: The one current x86 release artifact `/home/bl/misofm/engine/target/housekeeping-a/release/deps/transient_shaper-cd2278a8d4e49c42.s` contains packed `vmulps`/`vaddps` follower updates and `vdivps` ratios in the W4 corpus driver (lines 3327/3338/3341/3400) and W8 `Shaper::process_block` (12091/12101/12104/12162); scalar `vmulss` remains in its scalar driver (18499). Packed moves/spills, fixed lane extraction and scalar ramp advancement remain. No fused multiply/add instructions were found. These are current-lowering observations, not a base instruction-count or timing claim. No new lowering, ISA dispatch or arithmetic edit is justified; temporal follower/ramp dependencies preserve sample order, lane isolation forbids cross-track reductions, and existing W4/W8 packing plus scalar/tail handling remain.

Docs now describe the 64-sample corpus ramp within its first 128-frame block, unfused Lane::fma, Average's frozen half-product order without claiming every reparenthesization differs, and the unchanged derived restore step without an unsupported general one-ulp bound. Historical mutation evidence is identified as historical; no new mutation run is claimed.

**Retired coverage.** `bank_matches_scalar_pcm_state_and_reports_for_every_link_mode` was one full native 96-frame block: both-width variable-block padded differentials retain all link modes, unequal per-track defaults/automation, every partial count, per-frame/channel PCM, reports, full state and idle padding; the public randomized full-bank driver retains native full-bank and API paths. Width word comparisons, current coefficient/link/ramp/identity laws and the independent f64 oracle prevent vacuous shared-kernel agreement. `a_nonfinite_lane_is_rejected_alone` was one native four-frame NaN case: planted-state gates at both widths retain failing-channel zeroes/four cleared envelopes and active-vs-padding accounting; full/partial tripping controls retain overflow/NaN/infinity cases and subsequent bank-mate continuations, while randomized full-bank state comparisons retain state isolation. The scalar boundary's warm state/parameter preservation remains. G5 stays the sole digest owner: current width equality already compared every word, so its paired hashes and duplicate scalar rerender added no discrimination. Fixed render buffers remain WORDS long; the first differing word bounds diagnostics, and finite/nonvacuous word checks remain. Exact corpus inputs/pins and all five partition sizes [1, 7, 64, 128, 512] are unchanged.

### Root adversarial review — attempt 1

Root adversarial verdict: PASS. Reviewed all eleven checkpoint paths and the complete retained-purpose evidence. First-member preparation remains validated and seeded, and every later refusal still precedes fallback. Direct mutable partition slices preserve the supplied stream and all five block schedules; reference words are reused only after their independent stream is complete. The borrowed restore donor preserves ownership and peer-isolation checks. Width comparisons still examine every word in fixed-length buffers before owned scalar words are sorted for the same finite/diversity discriminator, so the paired SHA work and scalar self-rerender were redundant. Only the authorized unused package dependency/lock entry was removed. Both retired tests are subsets of retained variable-block, full-bank and hostile two-width owners. Kernel arithmetic, corpus inputs/pins, independent numeric bounds and state/admission contracts remain unchanged. All stated gates pass with the recorded debug/target/automation limits; current codegen supports the SIMD finding without a timing claim.

Test value: `every_width_produces_the_same_words` rejects direct W4/W8 lane/envelope divergence from the scalar corpus while its finite/diversity checks reject a degenerate shared generator; removing paired hashes preserves those defects. The scalar and native-bank partition tests reject boundary-dependent ramp/prefix advancement and changed final state at all five existing partitions, behavior absent from the fixed interior numeric rows. The bank ownership test rejects restoring/resetting a nonzero target through another lane or disturbing peers, using the same borrowed immutable donor. The descriptor/admission gate retains its public layout, latency/tail and resource-refusal contract; only an assertion of a fixed array's length was deleted. Existing coefficient/link and independent f64 gates retain their numeric purposes, with corrected claims. No new test or coverage reduction is hidden by the two subset retirements.
